stem.text: When $\text{O}_2$ reacts with $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ the products are $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{H}_2\text{O}$.
Mixture Y contains an equal number of the two molecules shown, and **no other molecules**.
Which statements about Y are correct?

items: If some oxygen molecules are removed from Y, the average $M_\text{r}$ of the mixture remains the same.
When mixture Y is ignited, some $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ remains unreacted.
